PhysicalPropertyTableImport.Notes: Source-explicit material keys only. Review Code Case acceptance, product specifications, heat treatment, construction section and temperature limits before import. No database writes. Missing cells are omitted, never zero or extrapolated.
PhysicalPropertyTableImport.SourceNotes: Section VIII Division 3; EN 10083-3:2006, quenched and tempered; no welding. Explicit TM-1 Group C, TE-1 Group 1, TCD Group C, PRD 1/2Cr to 1-1/4Cr direction. No UNS or exact nominal chemistry is supplied: manual identity assignment required.

Curve.notes: Code Case explicitly directs use of TM-1 curve tm-1-06. II-D source notes: Groups A-J use the compositions in source Notes 1-7 and 9-11. Source Notes 8 and 9 repeat Group H membership; the curve explicitly references Note 9. Note 5 includes variations of 9Cr-Mo, but only the literal composition is an automatic key. Note 13 names 15Cr-5Ni-3Mo for S15500; this is retained as printed, without correcting it to a database alias. Note 14 limits S45000 data to material aged at 480 degC; manual applicability review is required.

Curve.notes: Code Case explicitly directs use of TCD curve tcd-k-03. II-D source notes: Material Groups A-L use source Notes 1-12 (PDF pages 1236-1237). Group A matches the exact Nominal Composition label Carbon steel. Source Notes 9-11 restrict four compositions to 425 degC; maxTemperature on each identity enforces this limit in the reader. Note 9 prints 15Cr-5Ni-3Mo; retained as printed, not corrected to a different database composition. Note 10 explicitly permits separate S and Se compositions. Notes 10-12 also permit H/L/N/LN grades of austenitic stainless steels. Titanium grade/UNS identities are cross-referenced only from the explicit ASME TM-5 grade/UNS pairs, PDF page 1244. No numerical nominal composition is inferred from qualitative alloy labels or UNS.
